note: The pages carried through every Gate 2 render, browser and live check, one per role so a regression in any one role is visible. Keys and tiers are the corpus's own; presentFields counts the fields whose state is present in data/corpus-20k/fields/, questions counts the derived blocks in data/corpus-20k/questions/, and indexedAtThreshold11 says whether the key appears in gate2/lists-v2/indexed-t11.tsv. Tier 3 pages carry noindex by design, so they are absent from that list.
withdrawnSlotChange: Phase 5a tightened the withdrawn rule to require that no cleared register still records an active application for the moiety. Amlodipine no longer qualifies, so the withdrawn-arc role moves to rofecoxib, which is withdrawn under the final rule (ChEMBL drug_warning Withdrawn, Worldwide, 2004, reason cardiotoxicity) and is indexable at the deployed threshold of 11. Amlodipine stays in the list as a control: a page that the earlier rule called withdrawn and the final rule does not, so a regression that reintroduces the loose rule shows up as a withdrawal block on this page.

samples.withdrawnReasonSource: ChEMBL drug_warning Withdrawn (Worldwide; 2004), reason cardiotoxicity, CHEMBL122

samples.control: Withdrawn under the pre-Phase-5a rule, not withdrawn under the final rule. Its page must carry no withdrawal statement.
